statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to neurological and vestibular symptoms
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
